title: Douglas-Peucker simplification of the assembled graph (interior vertices that are not shared, geometry kept within eps) cuts the vertices per 100 m by at least a third at equal Q

a.recipe: assemble at the registry settings, then simplify_dp(g, 0.3): per polyline keep ends, nodes shared with another polyline and the Douglas-Peucker vertices (tolerance 0.3 m) between them; temp/loop21/e257_simplify.py writes the cards val_dp03.json
a.note: same raw outputs, same frames; only the output stage differs

c.recipe: the same models at the registry settings, no simplification (stored evaluate.py cards)
c.note: stored cards, reproduced by the script first (layer 1)

rule.note: KEEP the simplification as an output stage (candidate for assemble(), then reproduced through evaluate.py and reviewed) if vert100 a - c <= -3.0 on both models AND the guards hold: Q loss <= 0.003, F1@0.5 loss <= 0.005, topo F1 and J loss <= 0.005 / 0.01; else TIE or CUT

kill: none (CPU, 2 threads, about 15 minutes); layer 1 failure (the script does not reproduce the stored cards of the two models) stops the run
